info.title: Traigent TVL Reactive Policy Read Route
info.description: Authorized human portal read of the declared reactive policy of one agent (TRAIG-101 follow-up to S1). A portal catalog like agent_readiness: project and agent ids in the path are the plain ids the portal already holds and are authorized server-side; it is deliberately outside the optimization-channel content-class lint roots. The response schema (optimization/tvl_reactive_policy_schema.json) stays closed and content-class checked, and the route returns the server-issued agent_ref for every reactive route. See docs/tvl-reactive-contracts.md.

get.summary: Read the declared reactive policy of an agent
get.description: Authoritative policy read: declared rules (including rules that never fired and local guards), promotion gates and monitor control limits of the agent's current reactive policy in each environment. The response returns environments[{environment_ref, policy|null}], one entry per environment of the agent; policy is null for an environment that has no declared policy, and environments is empty when the agent has no environment. P-human only (portal/API session of a user with agent read access); an SDK API key is 403 forbidden. The agent is addressed by the plain agent_id the portal already holds, a portal-edge identifier that never reaches the Director bridge or observability; the project and agent are authorized first (a reference grants no access itself), then the response returns the server-issued agent_ref, which the portal uses unchanged for every other reactive route. Tenant and project come from the authenticated request context only (X-Tenant-Id, query strings and unknown body fields are never consulted or are refused). Dark behind PRODUCTION_REQUIREMENTS_ENABLED: while off the route answers the closed 404 {"success":false,"error":"reference_not_found","error_code":"reference_not_found","message":"Reference not found."} before authentication and body processing, indistinguishable from a missing or inaccessible reference. Every error body is the closed envelope tvl_reactive_common_schema.json#/definitions/Refusal except 429.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Project id of the portal request; authorized against the authenticated tenant.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: Agent id the portal already holds; authorized against the project before anything is returned.

200.description: environments[{environment_ref, policy|null}]: one entry per environment of the agent, with that environment's declared policy or null.

400.description: invalid_request. Closed envelope; nothing is echoed.

401.description: unauthenticated. Closed envelope; nothing is echoed.

403.description: forbidden, fact_source_not_permitted. Closed envelope; nothing is echoed.

404.description: reference_not_found. Closed envelope; nothing is echoed.

429.description: rate_limited. Closed envelope; nothing is echoed.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait; the only rate-limit detail on the wire.

500.description: internal_error. Closed envelope; nothing is echoed.

503.description: service_unavailable. Closed envelope; nothing is echoed.
